notes.title: Dinosaurs are history… now it's time for the medieval undead
notes.content:
Dinosis Survival was released years ago. It was a small, low-budget project, but it brought joy to many of you despite its limitations.

As a developer, I'm now returning to the roots of indie game development – building a game with no publisher, no external funding, and full creative freedom. That comes with challenges, but also with passion.

My new game is called BlackRoot – Medieval Survival.
It’s a brutal survival experience set in a cursed medieval world where the dead no longer stay dead. Dark forests, ruined villages, and a plague that twists everything it touches.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/29504540/9cde4314ca50b7cc922a6ac609532dd48a209b73.jpg[/img]

Just like Dinosis, BlackRoot is being made entirely independently – one person, one vision.

If you enjoy survival games with atmosphere, crafting, exploration, and danger lurking in every shadow, please consider adding BlackRoot to your wishlist:

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2241550/Blackroot_Medieval_Survival/

Every wishlist helps this project grow. Thank you for your support

notes.title: >Mars Taken - new game from Corpix Games
notes.content:
I like to announce my new game >Mars Taken.
If you liked Dinosis Survival check out >Mars Taken that is a TPP shooter with a deep story.
If you like Mars theme, deeper story and Roswell type of aliens this is something for you.
Add it to your wishlist and check out the trailer if you are interested. It will be released soon: 23 March.

http://store.steampowered.com/app/754610/Mars_Taken/

[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29504540/c0e421caef14c3fc272bfd17419becc801648ddf.jpg[/img]

After >Mars Taken will be released I'm getting back to dinosaurs. I want to create a completely new game with dinosaurs that will be a mix of Uncharted, The Last of Us and Jurassic Park.
I'm going to make a polished and greatest game with dinos ever so give me a support and buy >Mars Taken  :)

notes.title: Patch 1.01 notes
notes.content:
Hello,
A new patch is available.
Fixing a few most annoying issues in the game:
- code to the lock door don't disappear (if you forget the code you can reed it again)
- now all dinos give different amount of meat. It is more rewording to hunt big dinos.
- fixed some objects collisions
- fixed puzzle with code (now you can't walk over the wall)
- fixed puzzle with a canyon (now you can't walk over the canyon)
- fixed keybinding problems
- fixed invert mouse setting
